claims.text: HIS OWN DIA-FUNDED REFERENCE DOCUMENT DOES NOT MENTION THE HUTCHISON EFFECT. DIA-08-1003-017, 'Maverick Inventor Versus Corporate Inventor: Where Will the Next Major Innovations Arise?', cover-dated 30 March 2010, ICOD 1 December 2009, 20 pages as released, attributed on the DIA list of 9 January 2018 to Dr George Hathaway of Hathaway Consulting. Word counts over the whole released document: HUTCHISON 0, Pharos 0, levitation 0. Gravity occurs 12 times and antigravity 3. THE MAN WHO WROTE THE BOOK ON THE HUTCHISON EFFECT WROTE A DIA REFERENCE DOCUMENT ABOUT MAVERICK INVENTORS AND DID NOT MENTION IT. This is a fact about the document and is not a statement by him about the claim.

b.label: Maverick Inventor Versus Corporate Inventor: Where Will the Next Major Innovations Arise?

edges.label: produced under the AAWSA/AAWSAP contract, FY 2009
edges.note: The document's administrative note states it is 'one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program'. Issued as DIA-08-1003-017 on 30 March 2010, ICOD 1 December 2009. It is not a physics paper: it is a research-culture argument about whether breakthrough invention originates with lone inventors or corporate laboratories, which is the clearest single illustration of how loosely the DIRD mandate was drawn in practice.

edges.label: Registered engineer consulting on exotic materials, energy and propulsion; author of 'Mindbending: The Hutchison Files'
edges.note: THE BOARD'S ONLY DOCUMENTED LINK TO THE HUTCHISON CLAIM, AND IT RUNS THROUGH A PERSON RATHER THAN THROUGH ANY RECORD OF THE EFFECT. His firm's own page gives the University of Toronto electrical engineering degree of 1974, the professional registration, the consulting subjects and the book. NO HUTCHISON NODE EXISTS AND NONE SHOULD BE CREATED: no peer-reviewed publication and no primary record of a controlled demonstration was found, and his own DIA-funded reference document names Hutchison zero times.

edges.note: Hathaway Consulting was a one-man Toronto engineering consultancy with no independent DIA relationship; its deliverable reached DIA through the AAWSAP prime contract held by Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies. Tier 2 because the contractor name is redacted on the cover page under (b)(3):10 USC 424 and the subcontract has not been released. Reporting has separately characterised Hathaway as having ties to Bigelow's fringe and paranormal research interests, but no primary document establishing an employment or advisory relationship has been located.
